summary: Scheduled cohort CSV export strips tracehook params when ampersands present during retention compaction
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that scheduled cohort CSV exports generated since the nightly retention compaction on 2026-03-04 are missing tracehook query params that contain ampersands (e.g., route metadata like 'route=payroll&env=prod'). The tracehook column in the CSV shows truncated or URL-mangled values, causing downstream webhook processors to reject the links and resulting in missing trace links in customer analytics pipelines.

Impact:
- Customer's downstream alerting and ingestion systems can't resolve tracehooks for ~12% of rows in exported cohorts.
- Several scheduled reports are processed by internal analytics leading to missing attribution for alerts and billing reconciliation discrepancies.

Environment:
- Hosted Redwood Console (prod-us-east)
- Affected scheduled export jobs: BrightHealth cohort export jobs (org id hidden)

Expected behavior:
- CSV exports should preserve tracehook query params exactly (URL-encoded) so downstream systems can resolve them.

Actual behavior:
- Tracehook query strings that include ampersands are being re-serialized in the CSV with ampersands stripped or converted to plain whitespace or double-encoded sequences, breaking signature validation on our side and on customer side.

Workaround:
- Customer temporarily disabled scheduled CSV delivery and is running ad-hoc exports from the Console UI; ad-hoc UI exports are not affected.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create cohort with routes that include metadata keys containing ampersands in tracehook params (example route metadata: "route=payroll&env=prod").
2) Schedule a recurring CSV export for the cohort to run hourly via Console (scheduled-reports pipeline).
3) Wait for scheduled job to run after a retention compaction window (nightly compaction on 2026-03-04 introduced regression).
4) Download CSV and inspect the tracehook column; observe missing or mangled ampersand characters in query string portion of tracehook URL.
5) Compare with ad-hoc export via Console UI for the same cohort (works as expected).

investigation_notes: 03/05 09:12 - Triage: Reproduced on internal staging by running scheduled pipeline against test cohort with ampersand in metadata. Ad-hoc UI export preserved ampersand; scheduled job path produced mangled value.

03/05 11:03 - Hypothesis: Recent change to retention compaction code introduced a new serialization path (compact-serializer v2) that normalizes query params incorrectly when running under the scheduled-reports worker.

03/05 13:46 - Confirmed: compact-serializer v2 invoked for scheduled bulk exporters; it uses a legacy param-sanitizer that unescapes ampersand and replaces with space when compacted metadata is rehydrated. UI ad-hoc path uses live-serializer v3 which retains percent-encoding.
03/05 15:20 - Related commits: github.com/redwood/inference/commit/7b3a2c9 (introduces compact-serializer v2) — added for retention memory improvements.

03/06 08:30 - Customer impact analysis: BrightHealth observed ~12% of cohort rows affected across exports between 2026-03-04 and 2026-03-05. Exports after we revert scheduler to use live-serializer v3 show correct encoding.
03/07 10:05 - Regression test added to scheduled-reports CI that runs a cohort export with ampersand-containing params; test failed prior to patch.
comments: Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-05: Created ticket after customer reported missing trace links in scheduled exports; asked for sample CSV and job ids.
Customer (BrightHealth - ops@brighthealth) 2026-03-05: Provided sample CSVs and confirmed ad-hoc exports were fine. Asked for ETA because this breaks scheduled ingestion pipelines.

SRE (Liam O'Connor) 2026-03-05: Reproduced on staging, identified compact-serializer v2 path. Added temporary rollback to scheduler to force live-serializer v3 for scheduled-reports as hotfix (deployed to prod-us-east at 2026-03-06T02:15Z).
Engineering (Sofia Mendes) 2026-03-06: Confirmed hotfix restores correct encoding; creating PR to fix serializer logic to be encoding-preserving during compaction rehydrate: PR#3421.

Customer (BrightHealth) 2026-03-06: Confirmed scheduled exports after 02:20Z contain correct tracehook params. Thank you. Please confirm permanent fix timeline and whether historical exports can be reprocessed.

Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-07: Noted follow-up action item to discuss reprocessing options for affected historical exports; added to linked internal task INT-653210 for bulk re-export and re-delivery coordination.

Engineering (Sofia Mendes) 2026-03-08: PR#3421 merged to main; patch updates param-sanitizer to percent-encode ampersands and adds unit tests; scheduled rollout to prod-us-east on 2026-03-09 (canary first).
resolution: Hotfix: scheduler override to use live-serializer v3 deployed 2026-03-06; permanent fix merged in PR#3421 and scheduled for canary rollout 2026-03-09. Recommended action for customer: re-run affected scheduled exports or request support-assisted reprocess. Follow-up task (INT-653210) created to offer reprocessing and to run audit on all scheduled exports between 2026-03-04 and 2026-03-06.
